**Date created: November 13, 2026**

This page was built with R Markdown and the `leaflet` package. Click any marker
to see a popup about the landmark, hover to see its name, and use the mouse wheel
or the +/- buttons to zoom. The layer control (top right) lets you switch the
base map.

## The data

```{r data}
library(leaflet)

landmarks <- data.frame(
  name = c("Bayterek Tower", "Khan Shatyr", "Hazrat Sultan Mosque",
           "Big Almaty Lake", "Charyn Canyon", "Baikonur Cosmodrome",
           "Burabay National Park"),
  lat  = c(51.1283, 51.1326, 51.1228, 43.0500, 43.3500, 45.9650, 53.0833),
  lng  = c(71.4305, 71.4036, 71.4721, 76.9833, 79.0833, 63.3050, 70.3000),
  info = c("Observation tower in Astana symbolizing a mythical tree of life.",
           "A giant tent-shaped entertainment center in Astana.",
           "One of the largest mosques in Central Asia.",
           "A glacial alpine lake in the Trans-Ili Alatau mountains.",
           "A dramatic canyon often compared to the Grand Canyon.",
           "The world's first and largest operational space launch facility.",
           "A scenic area of lakes and granite hills known as the Switzerland of Kazakhstan."),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

knitr::kable(landmarks[, c("name", "info")], col.names = c("Landmark", "Description"))
```

## The map

```{r map, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
popups <- paste0("<b>", landmarks$name, "</b><br/>", landmarks$info)

leaflet(landmarks) %>%
  addTiles(group = "OpenStreetMap") %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron, group = "Light") %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery, group = "Satellite") %>%
  addMarkers(lng = ~lng, lat = ~lat,
             popup = popups,
             label = ~name,
             clusterOptions = NULL) %>%
  addCircles(lng = ~lng, lat = ~lat, radius = 25000,
             color = "#e63946", fillOpacity = 0.15, weight = 1) %>%
  addMiniMap(toggleDisplay = TRUE, position = "bottomleft") %>%
  addLayersControl(baseGroups = c("OpenStreetMap", "Light", "Satellite"),
                   options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)) %>%
  setView(lng = 67, lat = 48, zoom = 4)
```

*Map tiles by OpenStreetMap, CartoDB and Esri. Created in R Markdown with Leaflet on November 13, 2026.*
